bagPolicy.note: This is the Pirates' game-day policy. Concerts can differ, so check the event page before you go.

parking.note: PNC Park is on Pittsburgh's North Shore with Pirates-operated lots (Gold, Red, General Robinson Garage) right by the ballpark plus downtown garages reachable via a walk over the Roberto Clemente Bridge. Prepaid parking is recommended, and Light Rail (the 'T') is free to the North Shore station.

rideshare.note: For accessible passenger drop-off, use the zone along Mazeroski Way.

concessions.note: PNC Park offers a variety of food and beverage options including classic comfort foods with modern twists, such as Chicken Tenders & Fries, Cheeseburgers, and specialty hot dogs. Highlights include the Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Pastrami Fry, with a range of local and popular beers available at the Beer Garden.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available throughout the ballpark. If you need to exchange for an accessible seat, visit any ticket window or the Main Guest Relations Office at the bottom of the Home Plate Rotunda; all ticket windows are accessible. For help, call the Pirates Ticket Office at (412) 323-5000.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: For Pirates games, there is no re-entry once you exit PNC Park. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets you open in the MLB Ballpark app count as printed and can't be picked up at Will Call, so show them in the app at the gate. If you can't access your tickets, go to a Ticket Office window on game day, or contact Pirates Fan Services at 1-800-BUY-BUCS.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrances include the Edgar Snyder & Associates Home Plate Gate and the Left Field Gates, both with escalators to the concourses. For Pirates games, you can arrange a wheelchair at any entrance through a Game Day Team Member. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
